name: Kar Parts Direct Co Aftermarket Auto Body Parts
old_description: Your one-stop shop for all your CAPA and Aftermarket replacement auto body parts. Serving the Greater Los Angeles area for over 15+ Years!
about:
Kar Parts Direct Co operates from Gardena, California, with a second location in North Hollywood. Founded in 2011, the company has served the Greater Los Angeles area for over a decade as a supplier of aftermarket auto body parts. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company distributes CAPA-certified and aftermarket replacement auto body parts, maintaining an inventory of over 20,000 items including bumpers, fenders, and hoods. It offers will-call pickup and just-in-time delivery services from its two locations, supported by a fleet of branded delivery trucks and uniformed drivers. Quality verification processes include Vehicle Data Information (VDI), FMVSS-108 photometry durability testing, and Vehicle Test Fit (VTF) protocols.

Primary customers are collision repair shops, auto body shops, and automotive aftermarket businesses throughout Los Angeles County and surrounding cities. The company's product lines cover popular vehicle applications, and it emphasizes parts that fit without additional modification.

The company states its mission is to improve its business to satisfy customers through experienced staff, competitive pricing, and a broad product selection. It highlights CAPA-certified parts that undergo extensive testing as a quality differentiator.
